headline: the reasoning record of this book is thin: most attempts left no transcript at all, transcripts that were written are deleted mid-session, and the surviving transcripts contain no chain of thought - every thinking block in them is empty

the_correction_that_matters.the_fact: 35 of 41 attempts that produced this corpus left no surviving transcript
the_correction_that_matters.why_v1_got_it_wrong: the v1 manifest resolved every mapped attempt to a file that existed, so none looked missing; 27 of those files were zero bytes and carried nothing

the_larger_finding_v1_did_not_know.fact: the surviving transcripts contain NO chain of thought: every thinking block is an empty string with a signature
the_larger_finding_v1_did_not_know.source: the OW-6 stage-2 final checker, which read them
the_larger_finding_v1_did_not_know.consequence: OW-6's 'even chain of thought' and OW-6c's re-check of 'all chain of thought' are not partially satisfiable - they are not satisfiable at all from transcripts. What the transcript audit actually reads is actions, tool arguments, tool results, file writes and narration. That is genuinely valuable: it found undisclosed law breaches nothing else could see. It is not reasoning, and must never be presented to the owner as such.
the_larger_finding_v1_did_not_know.bearing_on_OW-6c: this is now an owner question, escalated by the final checker, not a note

controls_in_force: the mirror runs at every wave landing and before any final check is launched
audit slices resolve to the durable mirror first; a transcript held nowhere is REPORTED as lost
the durable store is swept so a held transcript missing from the manifest is still audited
_final_check_reconcile.py makes the coverage claim falsifiable; the close gate refuses on RED
the stage-2 checker must state transcript coverage and the gate asserts it did
remaining_risk: the mirror runs when the orchestrator runs it, so a transcript written and deleted between two runs is lost leaving only its manifest digest. The final checker ruled this residual window does NOT need an owner decision, because the dominant loss - transcripts the runtime never wrote - is not a cadence problem and no cadence recovers it.
